children: New Delhi, Nov. 7 -- Shares of Bayer CropScience Limited will remain in focus next week due to the upcoming record date for its Rs.90 per equity share dividend payout. The company also announced its second quarter result for the financial year 2026-27.
Bayer CropScience Limited share price closed 0.45% higher on Friday, after seeing 1.64% jump over the last five trading sessions.

The company's board of directors, on Tuesday, November 3, announced an interim dividend of Rs.90 per equity share with a face value of Rs.10 each (ie 900% of the face value) for FY27. The board has also fixed record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders for the payout.

The board fixed Thursday, November 12, as the record date to determine the eligibility of shareholders for the payout. Which means that investors must own the stock before the record date to qualify for the payout.
As per the company's BSE filing, the board will disburse the dividend payout among investors by Monday, November 30, 2026.

Alongside announcement of dividend, the company also reported a net profit of Rs.166.2 crore in the second quarter of FY27, against Rs.152.7 crore reported in the year ago period. Its net profit before tax (PBT) increased by 6% to Rs.211.4 crore during the quarter under review.

The stock closed 0.45% higher at Rs.3316.50 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.14,905.04 crore on Friday. The stock has surged 1.64% in one week, but has declined 6.17% in one month, 21.32% in three months and around 30.29% in one year.
